reading_rule.SPLIT_WEAKENS_A: split_effect_on_A mean > 0 with LCB95 > 0 -- the ATTACK/DEFEND split at k=1 costs Pole-A performance; investigate the split/defender stage, not the specialists
reading_rule.WEAKNESS_PREDATES_SPLIT: split_effect_on_A LCB95 <= 0 AND delta_A_presplit is not clearly larger than delta_A_split -- Pole-A separation was already weak after foundation/entity repair; inspect the specialist trajectory, not role allocation
reading_rule.SPLIT_HELPS_A: split_effect_on_A mean < 0 with UCB95 < 0 -- the split improves Pole A; the confirmatory shortfall is not the split
reading_rule.note: exploratory, n=128: a point-estimate localization aid. It licenses a scientifically motivated next change; it is not a confirmatory claim and does not revise efe4ee3c.
